import trimesh, numpy as np
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
box=trimesh.load('/work/checks/assembly/model.assembly.6ad4d964.stl')
lid=trimesh.load('/work/checks/assembly/model.assembly.2adfc722.stl')
pin=trimesh.load('/work/checks/assembly/model.assembly.1c4f9ecb.stl')
# Use vertex to triangle distance? trimesh.proximity.signed_distance? Let's use closest point via proximity
# For speed, sample vertices + use proximity.closest_point
def min_dist(A,B):
    # vertices of A to surface of B
    pts=A.vertices
    closest, dist, tri = trimesh.proximity.closest_point(B, pts)
    return dist.min(), pts[dist.argmin()], closest[dist.argmin()]
for name,A,B in [('box-lid',box,lid),('lid-box',lid,box),('box-pin',box,pin),('pin-box',pin,box)]:
    d, p, q = min_dist(A,B)
    print(name, d, 'Apt', p, 'Bpt', q)
